verdict.rationale: Terraform's own docs cover each step of the story. The official MCP server supports AI configuration generation and workspace run management (terraform-docs-40, terraform-docs-56, terraform-docs-65). `plan` previews changes and can save them with `-out` for a later apply (terraform-docs-15, terraform-docs-30). `show -json` and the `-json` streaming UI give machine-readable plan diffs (terraform-docs-48, terraform-docs-22), and `apply` prompts for approval before acting (terraform-docs-25), with a community user praising its meaningful diffs (terraform-comm-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of fully non-interactive plan runs (e.g. input suppression), and hands-on or independent evidence of an end-to-end agent-driven plan-and-approval workflow.
